guidance.text: Write the system as a specification for someone who will build it. REQUIREMENTS: one bullet per behaviour in EARS form: 'WHEN <trigger> THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>', 'WHILE <state> THE SYSTEM SHALL <response>', 'IF <condition> THEN <part> SHALL <response>', with exact values and timings. COMPONENTS and INTERFACES: the parts and what passes between them, with quantities.

name: SPEC
notes: EARS-style build specification (research: spec-driven development for AI builders)
